info.description: Back-office API of the Lestari point of sale. Every response uses the same envelope; lists put a page of rows in data, errors put a code (and field messages) there.
info.title: Lestari API

get.description: The products of every branch of the store with the prices each branch sells them at. Needs the business plugin.
The rows of the list (same filters and sorting, up to 50,000) as a file.

post.description: Sets the selling price of the products of the chosen branches to the price of the matching head-office product (the product it was copied from, or the one with the same SKU). Products that already have that price are left alone.

put.description: Changes the prices or availability of a product in its branch. Only the attributes present in the body are changed. When no value differs from the stored one nothing is written and updated_at stays as it was.

post.description: Starts a background job that sets the stock of every tracked product of the active branch to the sum of its stock movements.

post.description: Sends stock from the active branch to another branch of the store. The stock leaves the sender at once. Without confirmation it also arrives at once (status completed) and a product the receiver does not have yet is created there; with confirmation the transfer stays pending until the receiver accepts or rejects it.

delete.description: Only the sending branch can delete, and only while the transfer is pending. The stock goes back to the sender.

post.description: Only the receiving branch can accept, and only while the transfer is pending. The received stock is added to the branch; a quantity that did not arrive goes back to the sender.

parameters.description: quantities received, when they differ from what was sent
parameters.name: request

post.description: Only the receiving branch can reject, and only while the transfer is pending. The stock goes back to the sender.

mode.description: set makes the stock exactly quantity; add and subtract change it by quantity

unit_cost.description: with mode add: the cost of the units received; the product's purchase price becomes the weighted average

items.description: Items are the counted products; they are sent with a single stock opname, not with the list.

direction.description: out for the sending branch, in for the receiving one

items.description: Items are the products sent; they come with a single stock transfer, not with the list.

requires_confirmation.description: true: the stock arrives when the receiving branch accepts; false: it arrives at once
